translation: Not poisonous. Its chief actions are to dispel cold stirring within the brain, wind of the face moving to and fro, tearing of the eyes, copious nasal discharge and spittle, dizziness as if drunk, various cold qi, heart and abdominal pain, attack by noxious qi, sudden urgent swelling pain, wind-pain of the hypochondrium, and warming the center with endogenous cold. One name is 胡窮 [芎]
